services.name: Historic & Architectural Tour
services.desc: Experienced volunteer guides provide an in-depth look at the history and architecture of The Hanover Theatre on a two hour walking tour. A magnificent example of early 20th century theatre architecture, The Hanover Theatre was designed by Thomas Lamb, the foremost theatre and cinema architect of his day. As a nonprofit organization, The Hanover Theatre and Conservatory relies on the generosity of individuals, organizations and businesses to ensure that The Hanover Theatre remains a vibrant and welcoming destination where everyone can experience the transformative power of the performing arts.
